QUOTE: The REST call `ClientPosts.createPost` in `app/client/rest/posts.ts` (lines 43–48) passes `noRetry: true` to `doFetch`. So the client's own retry layer is explicitly disabled for this call.
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states the create-post request is never retried automatically and is sent once (`noRetry: true`, "Automatic retries: none").
